outline: 此課程旨在因應高階英語文學習者的需要，協助他們得到近乎英美人士的語言知識。詞彙學討論語言的約定俗成模式，譬如無所不在的固定/習慣性表達以及正確的字詞搭配方式。經由此課程，學生將獲得包含詞彙單位及其意義聯想、指認、使用情境的知識層面。

02	HOLIDAY
03	Phraseology: The periphery and the heart of language
04	Phraseology and language pedagogy (A)
05	Phraseology and language pedagogy (B)
06	Essential collocations for learners of English (A)
07	HOLIDAY
08 	Essential collocations for learners of English (B)
09	Essential collocations for learners of English (C)
10  Why can’t you just leave it alone? (A)
11  Why can’t you just leave it alone? (B)
12	Why can’t you just leave it alone? (C)
13	Multiword expressions and the digital turn (A)
14 	Multiword expressions and the digital turn (B)
15	Compilation, formalization and presentation of bilingual phraseology: Problems and possible solutions (A)
16	Compilation, formalization and presentation of bilingual phraseology: Problems and possible solutions  (B)
17  The phraseological patterns of high-frequency verbs in advanced English for general purposes: A corpus-driven approach to EFL textbook analysis (A)
18  The phraseological patterns of high-frequency verbs in advanced English for general purposes: A corpus-driven approach to EFL textbook analysis (B)
